author: DeDust
description: DeDust Factory V2 is the registry and deployment hub that creates and discovers DeDust v2 vaults, pools, operators, and deposit helpers.

declarations.name: Errors

members.name: InvalidOwnerSender
members.description: Incoming administration message sender is not the current Factory owner.

members.name: InvalidPendingOwnerSender
members.description: Ownership acceptance sender is not the pending owner.

members.name: OwnershipDelayNotElapsed
members.description: Ownership acceptance delay has not elapsed.

members.name: MissingChildCode
members.description: Requested child implementation code is not installed.

members.name: InvalidAssetOrProof
members.description: Asset tag or proof shape is invalid for this Factory.

members.name: InsufficientValue
members.description: Attached value cannot cover the required deployment budget.

members.name: InvalidVaultSender
members.description: Liquidity-deposit creation sender is not the authenticated Vault.

members.name: InvalidCodeVersion
members.description: Replacement code version is not the next version.

members.name: InvalidOperatorSender
members.description: Operator-only request sender is not the deterministic Operator contract.

members.name: UnsupportedOperation
members.description: Incoming internal message opcode is unsupported.

declarations.description: DeDust Factory v2 exit-code catalog.

declarations.name: DedustFactoryV2Ownership

fields.name: ownerAddress
fields.description: Current owner stack address; expected to be an internal address on live mainnet.

fields.name: pendingOwnerAddress
fields.description: Pending owner stack address, or `addr_none` when no transfer is pending.

fields.name: canAcceptAfter
fields.description: Unix timestamp after which the pending owner can accept.

declarations.description: Structured result returned by `get_ownership`.

get_methods.name: get_ownership
get_methods.description: Return current and pending owner addresses plus ownership acceptance timestamp.

get_methods.name: get_version
get_methods.description: Return the live Factory code/storage version.

get_methods.name: get_vault_address
get_methods.description: Return the deterministic Vault address for `asset`.

get_methods.name: get_pool_address
get_methods.description: Return the deterministic Pool address for `poolType` (`0` volatile, `1` stable) and assets.

get_methods.name: get_liquidity_deposit_address
get_methods.description: Return the deterministic Liquidity Deposit address for owner, pool type, and assets.
